title: Indian Ocean Tsunami
description:
The **Indian Ocean tsunami** on December 26, 2004, was triggered by a 9.1-9.3 magnitude earthquake off Sumatra, killing over 230,000 people in 14 countries.

It was one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history. Indonesia, Sri Lanka, India, and Thailand were hardest hit.

The disaster led to improved tsunami warning systems worldwide.
